topics.name: Release Candidate Identity
topics.purpose: Define each release candidate as an explicit immutable composition of exact package/module/contracts/runtime/config versions awaiting acceptance.

semantics.identity_rule: Each release candidate has an explicit identity.
semantics.build_rule: Build/reproducibility evidence is exact where applicable.
semantics.change_rule: Semantic/release diff against prior accepted release is explicit.
semantics.immutability_rule: Changing any member produces a new release candidate identity/revision.
semantics.authority_rule: Release candidate existence grants no deployment authority.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

references.purpose: Release candidates compose exact package artifacts.
